items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra's algorithm, designed by Dutch computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra in 1956 (famously in about twenty minutes over a cup of coffee), finds the shortest path between vertices in a weighted graph.", từ "famously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra's algorithm, designed by Dutch computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra in 1956 (famously in about twenty minutes over a cup of coffee), finds the shortest path between vertices in a weighted graph.", what does "famously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: famously /ˈfeɪ.məs.li/ (trạng từ): nổi tiếng là. Dùng để dẫn ra một chi tiết mà nhiều người đã biết: "famously in about twenty minutes" = nổi tiếng là chỉ trong khoảng hai mươi phút.
items.explanationEn: famously /ˈfeɪ.məs.li/ (adverb): as is well known. Introduces a detail many people already know: "famously in about twenty minutes" means it is well known he did it in about twenty minutes.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra's algorithm, designed by Dutch computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra in 1956 (famously in about twenty minutes over a cup of coffee), finds the shortest path between vertices in a weighted graph.", từ "vertex" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra's algorithm, designed by Dutch computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra in 1956 (famously in about twenty minutes over a cup of coffee), finds the shortest path between vertices in a weighted graph.", what does "vertex" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vertex /ˈvɜː.teks/ (danh từ): đỉnh (của đồ thị). Số nhiều bất quy tắc là "vertices"; trong đồ thị, các vertex được nối với nhau bằng edge.
items.explanationEn: vertex /ˈvɜː.teks/ (noun): a point in a graph. The plural is irregular: "vertices"; in a graph, vertices are connected by edges.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra's algorithm, designed by Dutch computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra in 1956 (famously in about twenty minutes over a cup of coffee), finds the shortest path between vertices in a weighted graph.", từ "weighted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra's algorithm, designed by Dutch computer scientist Edsger Dijkstra in 1956 (famously in about twenty minutes over a cup of coffee), finds the shortest path between vertices in a weighted graph.", what does "weighted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: weighted /ˈweɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): có trọng số. "A weighted graph" = đồ thị có trọng số, mỗi cạnh mang một con số như khoảng cách hoặc giá.
items.explanationEn: weighted /ˈweɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): having a cost value. "A weighted graph" is a graph where each edge carries a number such as distance or price.

items.question: Trong câu "It powers GPS routing, network routing (OSPF — Open Shortest Path First), cheapest flight searches, epidemic modelling and path-finding in games.", từ "power" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It powers GPS routing, network routing (OSPF — Open Shortest Path First), cheapest flight searches, epidemic modelling and path-finding in games.", what does "power" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: power /ˈpaʊ.ər/ (động từ): làm nền tảng cho. "X powers Y" = X là công nghệ đứng sau, vận hành Y; nghĩa khác là cấp điện/năng lượng.
items.explanationEn: power /ˈpaʊ.ər/ (verb): to be what drives. "X powers Y" means X is the technology that makes Y work; another sense is to supply electricity.

items.question: Trong câu "It powers GPS routing, network routing (OSPF — Open Shortest Path First), cheapest flight searches, epidemic modelling and path-finding in games.", từ "epidemic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It powers GPS routing, network routing (OSPF — Open Shortest Path First), cheapest flight searches, epidemic modelling and path-finding in games.", what does "epidemic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: epidemic /ˌep.ɪˈdem.ɪk/ (danh từ): dịch bệnh. "Epidemic modelling" = mô hình hóa sự lây lan của dịch bệnh, ví dụ tìm đường lây nhanh nhất.
items.explanationEn: epidemic /ˌep.ɪˈdem.ɪk/ (noun): a spreading disease. "Epidemic modelling" means simulating how a disease spreads, for example along the fastest paths.

items.question: Trong câu "BFS finds the path with the fewest edges, which is only the shortest path when every edge costs the same:", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BFS finds the path with the fewest edges, which is only the shortest path when every edge costs the same:", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): cạnh (nối hai đỉnh). Trong đồ thị, edge nối hai vertex; nghĩa đời thường là mép, rìa (the edge of the table).
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): a link between two nodes. In a graph, an edge links two vertices; the everyday sense is a border (the edge of the table).

items.question: Trong câu "As long as all edge weights are non-negative, Dijkstra computes the shortest distance from one source vertex to every other vertex (single-source shortest paths).", từ "as long as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As long as all edge weights are non-negative, Dijkstra computes the shortest distance from one source vertex to every other vertex (single-source shortest paths).", what does "as long as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as long as /æz ˈlɒŋ æz/ (cụm từ): miễn là. Nêu điều kiện bắt buộc: "as long as all edge weights are non-negative" = miễn là mọi trọng số không âm.
items.explanationEn: as long as /æz ˈlɒŋ æz/ (phrase): provided that. States a required condition: "as long as all edge weights are non-negative" means only if none is negative.

items.question: Trong câu "As long as all edge weights are non-negative, Dijkstra computes the shortest distance from one source vertex to every other vertex (single-source shortest paths).", từ "compute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As long as all edge weights are non-negative, Dijkstra computes the shortest distance from one source vertex to every other vertex (single-source shortest paths).", what does "compute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính toán. "Compute the shortest distance" = tính khoảng cách ngắn nhất; danh từ: computation.
items.explanationEn: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to calculate. "Compute the shortest distance" means calculate it; the noun is computation.

items.question: Trong câu "An ordinary adjacency list stores only neighbour names.", từ "ordinary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An ordinary adjacency list stores only neighbour names.", what does "ordinary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ordinary /ˈɔː.dɪn.ər.i/ (tính từ): thông thường. "An ordinary adjacency list" = danh sách kề thông thường, chưa có trọng số.
items.explanationEn: ordinary /ˈɔː.dɪn.ər.i/ (adjective): normal, regular. "An ordinary adjacency list" is the normal version, without weights.

items.question: Trong câu "An ordinary adjacency list stores only neighbour names.", từ "adjacency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An ordinary adjacency list stores only neighbour names.", what does "adjacency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the state of being next to
items.explanation: adjacency /əˈdʒeɪ.sən.si/ (danh từ): sự kề nhau. "Adjacency list" = danh sách kề, lưu các đỉnh liền kề với mỗi đỉnh; tính từ: adjacent.
items.explanationEn: adjacency /əˈdʒeɪ.sən.si/ (noun): the state of being next to. An "adjacency list" stores the vertices next to each vertex; the adjective is adjacent.

items.question: Trong câu "For a weighted graph every entry must also carry the edge's weight (distance, time, price…).", từ "entry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a weighted graph every entry must also carry the edge's weight (distance, time, price…).", what does "entry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: entry /ˈen.tri/ (danh từ): mục, phần tử. "Every entry" = mỗi mục trong danh sách; nghĩa khác là lối vào (entry gate).
items.explanationEn: entry /ˈen.tri/ (noun): an item in a list. "Every entry" means each item in the list; another sense is a way in (an entry gate).

items.question: Trong câu "For a weighted graph every entry must also carry the edge's weight (distance, time, price…).", từ "carry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a weighted graph every entry must also carry the edge's weight (distance, time, price…).", what does "carry" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: carry /ˈkær.i/ (động từ): mang theo (dữ liệu). "Carry the edge's weight" = mỗi mục chứa kèm trọng số; cụm liên quan: carry over (chuyển sang).
items.explanationEn: carry /ˈkær.i/ (verb): to hold along with it. "Carry the edge's weight" means each item holds the weight too; related: carry over.

items.question: Trong câu "For a directed graph, push only into vertex1's list.", từ "directed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a directed graph, push only into vertex1's list.", what does "directed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: directed /daɪˈrek.tɪd/ (tính từ): có hướng. "A directed graph" = đồ thị có hướng, cạnh chỉ đi một chiều; trái nghĩa: undirected.
items.explanationEn: directed /daɪˈrek.tɪd/ (adjective): going one way only. "A directed graph" has one-way edges; the opposite is undirected.

items.question: Trong câu "We will find the shortest path from A to E in this undirected graph:", từ "undirected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "We will find the shortest path from A to E in this undirected graph:", what does "undirected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: undirected /ˌʌn.daɪˈrek.tɪd/ (tính từ): vô hướng. "An undirected graph" = đồ thị vô hướng, mỗi cạnh đi được cả hai chiều.
items.explanationEn: undirected /ˌʌn.daɪˈrek.tɪd/ (adjective): having two-way links. "An undirected graph" lets every edge be used in both directions.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra keeps three pieces of state:", từ "state" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra keeps three pieces of state:", what does "state" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (danh từ): trạng thái. "Pieces of state" = các phần dữ liệu trạng thái mà thuật toán phải ghi nhớ; nghĩa khác là tiểu bang.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (noun): the stored condition. "Pieces of state" are the data an algorithm must remember; another sense is a region of a country.

items.question: Trong câu "previous — for each vertex, the vertex we came from on the best path found so far (all null at first).", từ "so far" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "previous — for each vertex, the vertex we came from on the best path found so far (all null at first).", what does "so far" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: so far /səʊ ˈfɑː/ (cụm từ): cho đến nay. "The best path found so far" = đường tốt nhất tìm được tính đến lúc này, có thể còn thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: so far /səʊ ˈfɑː/ (phrase): up to this point. "The best path found so far" is the best one up to now, which may still change.

items.question: Trong câu "Steps 3–4 are called relaxing an edge.", từ "relax" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Steps 3–4 are called relaxing an edge.", what does "relax" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to try improving via an edge
items.explanation: relax /rɪˈlæks/ (động từ): nới lỏng (cập nhật cạnh). "Relaxing an edge" = kiểm tra xem đi qua cạnh đó có rút ngắn khoảng cách không; nghĩa thường là thư giãn.
items.explanationEn: relax /rɪˈlæks/ (verb): to try improving via an edge. "Relaxing an edge" means checking whether going through it shortens a distance; the everyday sense is to rest.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 1 is a greedy choice: always expand the closest vertex.", từ "greedy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 1 is a greedy choice: always expand the closest vertex.", what does "greedy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: greedy /ˈɡriː.di/ (tính từ): tham lam. "A greedy choice" = lựa chọn tham lam, luôn lấy phương án tốt nhất tại thời điểm hiện tại.
items.explanationEn: greedy /ˈɡriː.di/ (adjective): taking the best now. "A greedy choice" always takes the option that looks best at the moment.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 1 is a greedy choice: always expand the closest vertex.", từ "expand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 1 is a greedy choice: always expand the closest vertex.", what does "expand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expand /ɪkˈspænd/ (động từ): mở rộng, duyệt tiếp. "Expand the closest vertex" = xét tiếp các đỉnh kề của đỉnh gần nhất; danh từ: expansion.
items.explanationEn: expand /ɪkˈspænd/ (verb): to explore further from. "Expand the closest vertex" means explore its neighbours next; the noun is expansion.

items.question: Trong câu "Every other route to the vertex would have to leave through some unvisited vertex whose distance is already at least as large, and adding non-negative edges can only make it longer.", từ "route" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every other route to the vertex would have to leave through some unvisited vertex whose distance is already at least as large, and adding non-negative edges can only make it longer.", what does "route" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way from A to B
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (danh từ): tuyến đường. "Every other route to the vertex" = mọi đường đi khác tới đỉnh; động từ "route" = định tuyến.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (noun): a way from A to B. "Every other route to the vertex" means any other way there; the verb "route" means to send along a path.

items.question: Trong câu "Ties are broken by insertion order.", từ "tie" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ties are broken by insertion order.", what does "tie" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tie /taɪ/ (danh từ): trường hợp hòa, bằng nhau. "Ties are broken by…" = khi bằng nhau thì phân xử theo…; cụm: break a tie.
items.explanationEn: tie /taɪ/ (noun): an equal result. "Ties are broken by…" means equal values are decided by…; collocation: break a tie.

items.question: Trong câu "Ties are broken by insertion order.", từ "insertion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ties are broken by insertion order.", what does "insertion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: insertion /ɪnˈsɜː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự chèn vào. "Insertion order" = thứ tự được thêm vào; động từ: insert.
items.explanationEn: insertion /ɪnˈsɜː.ʃən/ (noun): the act of adding in. "Insertion order" is the order items were added in; the verb is insert.

items.question: Trong câu "The previous table evolves alongside it:", từ "evolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The previous table evolves alongside it:", what does "evolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evolve /ɪˈvɒlv/ (động từ): thay đổi dần. "The table evolves" = bảng thay đổi dần qua từng bước; nghĩa sinh học là tiến hóa.
items.explanationEn: evolve /ɪˈvɒlv/ (verb): to change step by step. "The table evolves" means it changes gradually over the steps; the biology sense is to develop as a species.

items.question: Trong câu "The previous table evolves alongside it:", từ "alongside" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The previous table evolves alongside it:", what does "alongside" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (giới từ): song song với. "Evolves alongside it" = thay đổi song song, cùng lúc với bảng kia.
items.explanationEn: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (preposition): together with. "Evolves alongside it" means it changes at the same time as the other table.

items.question: Trong câu "Notice that E was first reached with distance 7 through B, then improved twice as better routes appeared.", từ "notice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Notice that E was first reached with distance 7 through B, then improved twice as better routes appeared.", what does "notice" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notice /ˈnəʊ.tɪs/ (động từ): để ý, nhận thấy. "Notice that…" = hãy để ý rằng…, dùng để kéo sự chú ý của người đọc; danh từ "notice" = thông báo.
items.explanationEn: notice /ˈnəʊ.tɪs/ (verb): to become aware of. "Notice that…" draws the reader's attention; the noun "notice" means an announcement.

items.question: Trong câu "The obvious two-edge route was not the shortest one.", từ "obvious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The obvious two-edge route was not the shortest one.", what does "obvious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: obvious /ˈɒb.vi.əs/ (tính từ): hiển nhiên, dễ thấy. "The obvious route" = con đường nhìn qua là thấy ngay, nhưng chưa chắc ngắn nhất.
items.explanationEn: obvious /ˈɒb.vi.əs/ (adjective): easy to see. "The obvious route" is the one you see at first glance, not necessarily the shortest.

items.question: Trong câu "Walk backwards from the target until you hit null, then reverse:", từ "backwards" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Walk backwards from the target until you hit null, then reverse:", what does "backwards" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: backwards /ˈbæk.wədz/ (trạng từ): ngược lại, lùi về. "Walk backwards from the target" = đi ngược từ đích về điểm xuất phát; trái nghĩa: forwards.
items.explanationEn: backwards /ˈbæk.wədz/ (adverb): toward the start. "Walk backwards from the target" means go from the end toward the start; the opposite is forwards.

items.question: Trong câu "Walk backwards from the target until you hit null, then reverse:", từ "reverse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Walk backwards from the target until you hit null, then reverse:", what does "reverse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (động từ): đảo ngược thứ tự. "Then reverse" = đảo ngược danh sách để có đường từ đầu đến cuối; nghĩa khác: hủy một quyết định.
items.explanationEn: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (verb): to flip the order. "Then reverse" means flip the list to get the path from start to end; another sense is to cancel a decision.

items.question: Trong câu "This is O(V) time and space in the worst case (a path can contain every vertex).", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is O(V) time and space in the worst case (a path can contain every vertex).", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "In the worst case" = trong trường hợp bất lợi nhất; đối lập: best case, average case.
items.explanationEn: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable input. "In the worst case" means for the least favourable input; compare best case and average case.

items.question: Trong câu "If distances[finish] is still Infinity, the target is unreachable from the start.", từ "unreachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If distances[finish] is still Infinity, the target is unreachable from the start.", what does "unreachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unreachable /ʌnˈriː.tʃə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể tới được. "Unreachable from the start" = không có đường nào từ điểm xuất phát tới đó; gốc: reach.
items.explanationEn: unreachable /ʌnˈriː.tʃə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to get to. "Unreachable from the start" means no path leads there; the root verb is reach.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra needs a structure that repeatedly hands back "the vertex with the smallest distance".", từ "repeatedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra needs a structure that repeatedly hands back "the vertex with the smallest distance".", what does "repeatedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (trạng từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Repeatedly hands back" = liên tục trả về nhiều lần; động từ: repeat.
items.explanationEn: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (adverb): again and again. "Repeatedly hands back" means it returns items again and again; the verb is repeat.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra needs a structure that repeatedly hands back "the vertex with the smallest distance".", từ "hand back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra needs a structure that repeatedly hands back "the vertex with the smallest distance".", what does "hand back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: hand back /ˌhænd ˈbæk/ (cụm từ): trả lại, đưa ra. "Hands back the vertex" = trả về đỉnh cho người gọi; gần nghĩa: return.
items.explanationEn: hand back /ˌhænd ˈbæk/ (phrase): to give back. "Hands back the vertex" means it returns it to the caller; similar to return.

items.question: Trong câu "It is easy to read and correct, but it is wasteful: sorting the whole array to add one item costs O(n log n), and shift costs O(n).", từ "wasteful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is easy to read and correct, but it is wasteful: sorting the whole array to add one item costs O(n log n), and shift costs O(n).", what does "wasteful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: wasteful /ˈweɪst.fəl/ (tính từ): lãng phí. "It is wasteful" = tốn tài nguyên hơn cần thiết; danh từ: waste.
items.explanationEn: wasteful /ˈweɪst.fəl/ (adjective): using more than needed. "It is wasteful" means it uses more resources than necessary; the noun is waste.

items.question: Trong câu "Initialise distances and previous, enqueue the start with priority 0, then loop: dequeue the smallest, skip it if already visited, stop at the finish, otherwise relax its edges and enqueue every neighbour whose distance improved.", từ "initialise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initialise distances and previous, enqueue the start with priority 0, then loop: dequeue the smallest, skip it if already visited, stop at the finish, otherwise relax its edges and enqueue every neighbour whose distance improved.", what does "initialise" (verb) mean?
options: khởi tạo giá trị ban đầu
items.explanation: initialise /ɪˈnɪʃ.əl.aɪz/ (động từ): khởi tạo giá trị ban đầu. "Initialise distances" = gán giá trị ban đầu cho bảng khoảng cách; kiểu Mỹ viết initialize.
items.explanationEn: initialise /ɪˈnɪʃ.əl.aɪz/ (verb): to set starting values. "Initialise distances" means give the table its first values; American spelling is initialize.

items.question: Trong câu "Initialise distances and previous, enqueue the start with priority 0, then loop: dequeue the smallest, skip it if already visited, stop at the finish, otherwise relax its edges and enqueue every neighbour whose distance improved.", từ "skip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initialise distances and previous, enqueue the start with priority 0, then loop: dequeue the smallest, skip it if already visited, stop at the finish, otherwise relax its edges and enqueue every neighbour whose distance improved.", what does "skip" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to miss a class on purpose
items.explanation: skip /skɪp/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "Skip it if already visited" = bỏ qua nếu đã thăm; cụm: skip a step.
items.explanationEn: skip /skɪp/ (verb): to pass over. "Skip it if already visited" means pass over it; collocation: skip a step.

items.question: Trong câu "Initialise distances and previous, enqueue the start with priority 0, then loop: dequeue the smallest, skip it if already visited, stop at the finish, otherwise relax its edges and enqueue every neighbour whose distance improved.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initialise distances and previous, enqueue the start with priority 0, then loop: dequeue the smallest, skip it if already visited, stop at the finish, otherwise relax its edges and enqueue every neighbour whose distance improved.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Otherwise relax its edges" = nếu không rơi vào các trường hợp trên thì nới lỏng cạnh; nghĩa khác: theo cách khác.
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (adverb): if not. "Otherwise relax its edges" means if none of the earlier cases apply; another sense is in a different way.

items.question: Trong câu "When a vertex's distance improves we simply enqueue it again instead of updating its old entry.", từ "instead of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a vertex's distance improves we simply enqueue it again instead of updating its old entry.", what does "instead of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "Enqueue it again instead of updating" = thêm lại vào hàng đợi thay vì sửa mục cũ.
items.explanationEn: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (phrase): in place of. "Enqueue it again instead of updating" means add a new entry rather than change the old one.

items.question: Trong câu "The older, larger entry becomes stale; when it is eventually dequeued, the visited check throws it away.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The older, larger entry becomes stale; when it is eventually dequeued, the visited check throws it away.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, cũ. "The entry becomes stale" = mục đã lỗi thời vì có giá trị mới hơn; nghĩa gốc: bánh mì bị cũ, ôi.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): no longer current. "The entry becomes stale" means a newer value replaced it; the original sense is old, dry bread.

items.question: Trong câu "The older, larger entry becomes stale; when it is eventually dequeued, the visited check throws it away.", từ "eventually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The older, larger entry becomes stale; when it is eventually dequeued, the visited check throws it away.", what does "eventually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: eventually /ɪˈven.tʃu.ə.li/ (trạng từ): cuối cùng, rốt cuộc. "When it is eventually dequeued" = khi rốt cuộc nó được lấy ra; lưu ý: không có nghĩa "có lẽ".
items.explanationEn: eventually /ɪˈven.tʃu.ə.li/ (adverb): in the end. "When it is eventually dequeued" means when it finally comes out; it does not mean "possibly".

items.question: Trong câu "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", từ "heap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", what does "heap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: heap /hiːp/ (danh từ): đống (cấu trúc dữ liệu). "A min binary heap" = cây nhị phân mà nút gốc luôn nhỏ nhất; nghĩa thường: một đống đồ.
items.explanationEn: heap /hiːp/ (noun): a tree-based data structure. "A min binary heap" is a binary tree whose root is always the smallest; the everyday sense is a pile of things.

items.question: Trong câu "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): trình bày, đề cập. "Covered in the heaps topic" = đã được trình bày trong chủ đề heap; nghĩa khác: che phủ.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to deal with a subject. "Covered in the heaps topic" means explained there; another sense is to put something over.

items.question: Trong câu "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", từ "priority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", what does "priority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): độ ưu tiên. "The smallest priority" = giá trị ưu tiên nhỏ nhất; cụm: priority queue (hàng đợi ưu tiên).
items.explanationEn: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): rank of importance. "The smallest priority" is the lowest priority value; collocation: priority queue.

items.question: Trong câu "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", từ "binary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A min binary heap (covered in the heaps topic) keeps the smallest priority at index 0, with children of index i at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.", what does "binary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: binary /ˈbaɪ.nər.i/ (tính từ): nhị phân (hai nhánh). "Binary heap" = heap mà mỗi nút có tối đa hai con; cũng dùng trong binary search, binary tree.
items.explanationEn: binary /ˈbaɪ.nər.i/ (adjective): having two parts. A "binary heap" gives each node at most two children; also in binary search and binary tree.

items.question: Trong câu "Insert and extract-min are both O(log n)", từ "extract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insert and extract-min are both O(log n)", what does "extract" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to obtain a juice or oil
items.explanation: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (động từ): lấy ra, rút ra. "Extract-min" = lấy phần tử nhỏ nhất ra khỏi heap; danh từ: extraction.
items.explanationEn: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (verb): to take out. "Extract-min" removes and returns the smallest element; the noun is extraction.

items.question: Trong câu "Because it exposes the same enqueue / dequeue / isEmpty interface, the only change in dijkstra is one line", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because it exposes the same enqueue / dequeue / isEmpty interface, the only change in dijkstra is one line", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): cung cấp ra ngoài. "Exposes the same interface" = công khai cùng bộ phương thức cho code bên ngoài dùng.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to make available to users. "Exposes the same interface" means it offers the same public methods to outside code.

items.question: Trong câu "Because it exposes the same enqueue / dequeue / isEmpty interface, the only change in dijkstra is one line", từ "interface" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because it exposes the same enqueue / dequeue / isEmpty interface, the only change in dijkstra is one line", what does "interface" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interface /ˈɪn.tə.feɪs/ (danh từ): giao diện lập trình. "The same interface" = cùng bộ hàm enqueue/dequeue/isEmpty, nên có thể thay thế cho nhau.
items.explanationEn: interface /ˈɪn.tə.feɪs/ (noun): the set of public methods. "The same interface" means the same enqueue/dequeue/isEmpty methods, so one can replace the other.

items.question: Trong câu "Queue contents during our trace (stale entries marked *)", từ "content" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Queue contents during our trace (stale entries marked *)", what does "content" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: content /ˈkɒn.tent/ (danh từ): những thứ chứa bên trong. Thường ở số nhiều: "queue contents" = các phần tử đang nằm trong hàng đợi.
items.explanationEn: content /ˈkɒn.tent/ (noun): what is held inside. Usually plural: "queue contents" are the items currently inside the queue.

items.question: Trong câu "Queue contents during our trace (stale entries marked *)", từ "mark" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Queue contents during our trace (stale entries marked *)", what does "mark" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mark /mɑːk/ (động từ): đánh dấu. "Stale entries marked *" = các mục cũ được đánh dấu bằng dấu *; cụm: mark as visited.
items.explanationEn: mark /mɑːk/ (verb): to label with a sign. "Stale entries marked *" are labelled with a star; collocation: mark as visited.

items.question: Trong câu "Every edge is relaxed at most once per direction, so there are O(E) enqueues and O(E) dequeues.", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every edge is relaxed at most once per direction, so there are O(E) enqueues and O(E) dequeues.", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /ət ˈməʊst/ (cụm từ): nhiều nhất là. "Relaxed at most once" = được nới lỏng tối đa một lần; trái nghĩa: at least.
items.explanationEn: at most /ət ˈməʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "Relaxed at most once" means no more than one time; the opposite is at least.

items.question: Trong câu "Every edge is relaxed at most once per direction, so there are O(E) enqueues and O(E) dequeues.", từ "per" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every edge is relaxed at most once per direction, so there are O(E) enqueues and O(E) dequeues.", what does "per" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: per /pɜːr/ (giới từ): cho mỗi. "Once per direction" = một lần cho mỗi chiều; cụm quen thuộc: per second, per user.
items.explanationEn: per /pɜːr/ (preposition): for each. "Once per direction" means one time for each direction; common in per second, per user.

items.question: Trong câu "Every edge is relaxed at most once per direction, so there are O(E) enqueues and O(E) dequeues.", từ "direction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every edge is relaxed at most once per direction, so there are O(E) enqueues and O(E) dequeues.", what does "direction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: direction /daɪˈrek.ʃən/ (danh từ): chiều, hướng. "Per direction" = mỗi chiều của cạnh vô hướng (A→B và B→A); số nhiều "directions" còn nghĩa là chỉ dẫn.
items.explanationEn: direction /daɪˈrek.ʃən/ (noun): the way something goes. "Per direction" means each way along an undirected edge; plural "directions" can also mean instructions.

items.question: Trong câu "The lazy heap holds up to O(E) entries, so operations cost O(log E); since E ≤ V², log E ≤ 2 log V = O(log V).", từ "up to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lazy heap holds up to O(E) entries, so operations cost O(log E); since E ≤ V², log E ≤ 2 log V = O(log V).", what does "up to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up to /ˈʌp tuː/ (cụm từ): tối đa, lên tới. "Holds up to O(E) entries" = chứa tối đa O(E) mục; "it's up to you" lại nghĩa là tùy bạn.
items.explanationEn: up to /ˈʌp tuː/ (phrase): as many as. "Holds up to O(E) entries" means as many as O(E); "it's up to you" instead means you decide.

items.question: Trong câu "The lazy heap holds up to O(E) entries, so operations cost O(log E); since E ≤ V², log E ≤ 2 log V = O(log V).", từ "operation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lazy heap holds up to O(E) entries, so operations cost O(log E); since E ≤ V², log E ≤ 2 log V = O(log V).", what does "operation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: operation /ˌɒp.ərˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): thao tác. "Operations cost O(log E)" = mỗi thao tác (thêm/lấy ra) tốn O(log E).
items.explanationEn: operation /ˌɒp.ərˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a single action on data. "Operations cost O(log E)" means each action such as insert or remove takes O(log E).

items.question: Trong câu "Sparse graph (E ≈ V): heap ≈ O(V log V).", từ "sparse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sparse graph (E ≈ V): heap ≈ O(V log V).", what does "sparse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sparse /spɑːs/ (tính từ): thưa. "Sparse graph" = đồ thị thưa, số cạnh xấp xỉ số đỉnh; trái nghĩa: dense.
items.explanationEn: sparse /spɑːs/ (adjective): having few items. A "sparse graph" has about as many edges as vertices; the opposite is dense.

items.question: Trong câu "Dense graph (E ≈ V²): heap is O(V² log V), so the plain O(V²) array scan can win.", từ "dense" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dense graph (E ≈ V²): heap is O(V² log V), so the plain O(V²) array scan can win.", what does "dense" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dense /dens/ (tính từ): dày đặc. "Dense graph" = đồ thị dày, số cạnh gần V²; nghĩa khác: văn bản khó hiểu (dense text).
items.explanationEn: dense /dens/ (adjective): packed closely. A "dense graph" has close to V² edges; another sense is hard to follow (dense text).

items.question: Trong câu "Dense graph (E ≈ V²): heap is O(V² log V), so the plain O(V²) array scan can win.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dense graph (E ≈ V²): heap is O(V² log V), so the plain O(V²) array scan can win.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): đơn giản, thuần. "The plain array scan" = cách quét mảng đơn giản, không dùng cấu trúc phụ; cụm: plain text.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): simple, basic. "The plain array scan" is the simple approach with no extra structure; collocation: plain text.

items.question: Trong câu "Dense graph (E ≈ V²): heap is O(V² log V), so the plain O(V²) array scan can win.", từ "scan" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dense graph (E ≈ V²): heap is O(V² log V), so the plain O(V²) array scan can win.", what does "scan" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (danh từ): lượt quét qua. "Array scan" = duyệt qua toàn bộ mảng để tìm giá trị nhỏ nhất; động từ cũng là scan.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (noun): a pass through all items. An "array scan" goes through every element to find the minimum; the verb is also scan.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra's greedy step assumes that once a vertex is the closest one, nothing discovered later can make it closer.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra's greedy step assumes that once a vertex is the closest one, nothing discovered later can make it closer.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định. "The greedy step assumes that…" = bước tham lam mặc định cho rằng…; nghĩa khác: đảm nhận (assume a role).
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take as true. "The greedy step assumes that…" means it takes it as true; another sense is to take on (assume a role).

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra's greedy step assumes that once a vertex is the closest one, nothing discovered later can make it closer.", từ "discover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra's greedy step assumes that once a vertex is the closest one, nothing discovered later can make it closer.", what does "discover" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find for the first time
items.explanation: discover /dɪˈskʌv.ər/ (động từ): phát hiện, tìm thấy. "Nothing discovered later" = không có gì phát hiện sau đó; danh từ: discovery.
items.explanationEn: discover /dɪˈskʌv.ər/ (verb): to find for the first time. "Nothing discovered later" means nothing found afterwards; the noun is discovery.

items.question: Trong câu "A negative edge breaks that assumption:", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A negative edge breaks that assumption:", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Breaks that assumption" = làm giả định đó sai; cụm: make an assumption.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something taken as true. "Breaks that assumption" makes it no longer true; collocation: make an assumption.

items.question: Trong câu "With a negative cycle "shortest path" is not even defined, because looping forever keeps lowering the cost.", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a negative cycle "shortest path" is not even defined, because looping forever keeps lowering the cost.", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a path that returns to its start
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (danh từ): chu trình (vòng trong đồ thị). "Negative cycle" = chu trình có tổng trọng số âm; nghĩa khác: chu kỳ (business cycle).
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (noun): a path that returns to its start. A "negative cycle" is a loop whose total weight is negative; another sense is a repeating period.

items.question: Trong câu "With a negative cycle "shortest path" is not even defined, because looping forever keeps lowering the cost.", từ "lower" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a negative cycle "shortest path" is not even defined, because looping forever keeps lowering the cost.", what does "lower" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lower /ˈləʊ.ər/ (động từ): làm giảm. "Keeps lowering the cost" = liên tục làm chi phí giảm xuống; tính từ lower = thấp hơn.
items.explanationEn: lower /ˈləʊ.ər/ (verb): to make smaller. "Keeps lowering the cost" means making it smaller again and again; the adjective lower means less high.

items.question: Trong câu "Adding a constant to every edge to make them non-negative does not work: it penalises paths with more edges and changes which path is shortest.", từ "constant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adding a constant to every edge to make them non-negative does not work: it penalises paths with more edges and changes which path is shortest.", what does "constant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (danh từ): hằng số. "Adding a constant to every edge" = cộng cùng một hằng số vào mọi cạnh; tính từ: không đổi.
items.explanationEn: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (noun): a fixed value. "Adding a constant to every edge" means adding the same fixed number; as an adjective it means unchanging.

items.question: Trong câu "Adding a constant to every edge to make them non-negative does not work: it penalises paths with more edges and changes which path is shortest.", từ "penalise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adding a constant to every edge to make them non-negative does not work: it penalises paths with more edges and changes which path is shortest.", what does "penalise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: penalise /ˈpiː.nə.laɪz/ (động từ): gây bất lợi cho. "It penalises paths with more edges" = đường nhiều cạnh bị cộng thêm nhiều, nên chịu thiệt; Mỹ: penalize.
items.explanationEn: penalise /ˈpiː.nə.laɪz/ (verb): to put at a disadvantage. "It penalises paths with more edges" means those paths gain extra cost; American spelling is penalize.

items.question: Trong câu "Without the early exit, one run gives distances to every vertex, and previous forms a shortest-path tree.", từ "form" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without the early exit, one run gives distances to every vertex, and previous forms a shortest-path tree.", what does "form" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: form /fɔːm/ (động từ): tạo thành. "Previous forms a shortest-path tree" = bảng previous tạo thành một cây đường ngắn nhất.
items.explanationEn: form /fɔːm/ (verb): to make up. "Previous forms a shortest-path tree" means together its links make up that tree.

items.question: Trong câu "Grid: each cell is a vertex, the weight is the cost of entering a cell.", từ "grid" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Grid: each cell is a vertex, the weight is the cost of entering a cell.", what does "grid" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: grid /ɡrɪd/ (danh từ): lưới ô vuông. "Grid" = lưới ô, mỗi ô là một đỉnh (như bản đồ trong game); nghĩa khác: lưới điện.
items.explanationEn: grid /ɡrɪd/ (noun): a pattern of squares. A "grid" is a pattern of cells where each cell is a vertex, like a game map; another sense is a power network.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra expands equally in every direction.", từ "equally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra expands equally in every direction.", what does "equally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: equally /ˈiː.kwə.li/ (trạng từ): đều nhau, như nhau. "Expands equally in every direction" = lan rộng đều về mọi hướng, không ưu tiên hướng nào.
items.explanationEn: equally /ˈiː.kwə.li/ (adverb): to the same degree. "Expands equally in every direction" means it spreads out the same way on all sides.

items.question: Trong câu "BFS is a special case: with every weight equal to 1, the priority queue behaves like a FIFO queue.", từ "special case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BFS is a special case: with every weight equal to 1, the priority queue behaves like a FIFO queue.", what does "special case" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a narrower version of a rule
items.explanation: special case /ˌspeʃ.əl ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp đặc biệt. "BFS is a special case" = BFS là trường hợp riêng của Dijkstra khi mọi trọng số bằng nhau.
items.explanationEn: special case /ˌspeʃ.əl ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): a narrower version of a rule. "BFS is a special case" means it is Dijkstra restricted to equal weights.

items.question: Trong câu "BFS is a special case: with every weight equal to 1, the priority queue behaves like a FIFO queue.", từ "behave" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BFS is a special case: with every weight equal to 1, the priority queue behaves like a FIFO queue.", what does "behave" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work in a certain way
items.explanation: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (động từ): hoạt động, vận hành. "Behaves like a FIFO queue" = hoạt động giống hàng đợi FIFO; danh từ: behaviour.
items.explanationEn: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (verb): to work in a certain way. "Behaves like a FIFO queue" means it works like one; the noun is behaviour.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra = single-source shortest paths, non-negative weights; BFS only handles equal weights.", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra = single-source shortest paths, non-negative weights; BFS only handles equal weights.", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý được. "BFS only handles equal weights" = BFS chỉ xử lý đúng khi trọng số bằng nhau; danh từ "handle" = tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with. "BFS only handles equal weights" means it only works correctly for them; the noun "handle" is a grip.

items.question: Trong câu "Binary heap: O((V + E) log V) time, O(V + E) space; array scan O(V²) suits dense graphs.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Binary heap: O((V + E) log V) time, O(V + E) space; array scan O(V²) suits dense graphs.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "Array scan suits dense graphs" = quét mảng hợp với đồ thị dày; tính từ: suitable.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "Array scan suits dense graphs" means it is the right fit for them; the adjective is suitable.

items.question: Trong câu "Lazy deletion: enqueue duplicates, skip stale entries.", từ "duplicate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lazy deletion: enqueue duplicates, skip stale entries.", what does "duplicate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (danh từ): bản trùng lặp. "Enqueue duplicates" = thêm các mục trùng cho cùng một đỉnh; động từ duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (noun): an extra copy. "Enqueue duplicates" means add repeated entries for the same vertex; the verb is pronounced /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "Lazy deletion: enqueue duplicates, skip stale entries.", từ "deletion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lazy deletion: enqueue duplicates, skip stale entries.", what does "deletion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deletion /dɪˈliː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự xóa. "Lazy deletion" = xóa lười, không xóa ngay mà bỏ qua mục cũ khi gặp; động từ: delete.
items.explanationEn: deletion /dɪˈliː.ʃən/ (noun): the act of removing. "Lazy deletion" means not removing items at once but skipping old ones later; the verb is delete.

items.question: Trong câu "Dijkstra greedily visits the closest unvisited vertex and relaxes its edges.", từ "greedily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dijkstra greedily visits the closest unvisited vertex and relaxes its edges.", what does "greedily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: greedily /ˈɡriː.dɪ.li/ (trạng từ): một cách tham lam. "Greedily visits the closest vertex" = luôn chọn đỉnh gần nhất trước; tính từ: greedy.
items.explanationEn: greedily /ˈɡriː.dɪ.li/ (adverb): by taking the best now. "Greedily visits the closest vertex" means it always picks the nearest one first; the adjective is greedy.

items.question: Trong câu "The priority queue decides performance; a binary heap gives O((V + E) log V).", từ "performance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The priority queue decides performance; a binary heap gives O((V + E) log V).", what does "performance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: performance /pəˈfɔː.məns/ (danh từ): hiệu năng. "The priority queue decides performance" = hàng đợi ưu tiên quyết định tốc độ; nghĩa khác: buổi biểu diễn.
items.explanationEn: performance /pəˈfɔː.məns/ (noun): how fast it runs. "The priority queue decides performance" means it determines speed; another sense is a stage show.
